items.h: Bracket Support: Full-height and low-profile included

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your server networking with the Intel X710-DA2 Dual Port 10Gb SFP+ Network Adapter, designed for high-performance data centers, enterprise servers, and advanced networking environments. Built with the powerful Intel X710 controller, this PCIe 3.0 x8 network card delivers ultra-fast 10Gbps connectivity, low latency, and reliable performance for demanding workloads.


The Intel X710-DA2 features dual SFP+ ports, allowing flexible connectivity using fiber optic modules or DAC cables. It is ideal for virtualization, cloud computing, NAS storage, and enterprise networking solutions.


Key Features:


  • Dual Port 10GbE SFP+ connectivity
  • PCI Express 3.0 x8 high-speed interface
  • Intel X710 advanced Ethernet controller
  • Supports 10GbE and 1GbE network speeds
  • Virtualization support (SR-IOV, VMDq, Intel VT-c)
  • Low latency with advanced traffic management
  • Compatible with DAC cables and SFP+ optical transceivers
  • Energy-efficient and enterprise-grade reliability
